messages.body_plain:
Which website are you looking at?  datadr.org <http://datadr.org> is out of date.  We have moved to tessera.io <http://tessera.io>.  There you can find instructions to get set up with a vagrant vm.  This is easier to keep up to date because we just update the provisioning scripts instead of an entire image.  Take a look there and see if that will help.
